title: bulbophyllum odoratum
intro: Bulbophyllum odoratum, commonly known as the "fragrant orchid" due to its distinctive scent, is a species of orchid found in the tropical forests of Southeast Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Bulbophyllum odoratum include its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve respiratory symptoms, and act as an antispasmodic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its distinct fragrance.
